notes.title: Anniversary Update: New Maps!
notes.notes:
Hey Callasians!

It's been a year since Legends of Callasia officially launched here on Steam and to celebrate, we've added not just one but THREE NEW MAPS! Download the latest patch to get the new content (available on the full version only).

[h1]Magerock (2P)[/h1]
Spinning out into the darkness from the larger Tourmalan Isles lie the small isles that surround the shallow Blindfish Sea. In many places shallow enough for even a Stoneborne child to stand, its sandy floor separates a series of wild sparsely populated isles. It is a forgotten land, an afterthought often forgotten on even the best maps of the Great Undersea.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11906334/79c871f1e8cd0906d1287f26ba018d587a99f3de.jpg[/img]

[h1]The Heatherlands (2P)[/h1]
The twin Kingdoms of Turan and The Heatherlands lay on either side of the thick Deadleaf Jungle, separated by a shallow and treacherous bay of the same name. it is a land of heat, storms, and wild animals that prowl beneath massive fronts of unmapped jungles.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11906334/c1d1c5ca74b4450d69ebed920547769d7d89371e.jpg[/img]

[h1]Hapi Throne (6P)[/h1]
The Inner and Outer Squid Seas lie within the embracing arms of the Southern coast of Alyssia, placid waters that run surprisingly deep, rich in sealife and questionable creatures. At the center of this sea lies the ancient sacred Isle of Hapi, the spiritual hear of Alyssia.

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11906334/8bbc3f2f7c395ccffa6f3c8c8fa93e7d3175598f.jpg[/img]

This update also includes name changes in [b]The Neck (8P)[/b].

Thank you very much for supporting Legends of Callasia! For comments and suggestions, drop by our [url=https://discord.gg/VQPuk7N]Discord server[/url] and watch our livestreams on [url=http://twitch.tv/ninesquirrels]Twitch[/url].You can also email us at legends@boomzap.com or contact us through the in-game Feedback button.

notes.title: Update from the creators of Legends of Callasia
notes.notes:
Hey Callasians!

Hope you're all enjoying the new maps we're adding to the game. Meanwhile, we are also working on some non-Callasia things, and if you're ready to get hyped, continue reading below.

[h1]New Steam Group[/h1] 
More Boomzap games will be coming to Steam! Instead of having separate Steam groups for each, there's only one group for you to join where you can find all the news and discussions on Legends of Callasia and our other upcoming titles. All Boomzap news in one place!

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11906334/eac9831b85d4121db80513cc06cc416aa1528139.jpg[/img]

Join the new official Boomzap group here: http://steamcommunity.com/groups/boomzap

We want this to be a place you can all chat and hangout in, so suggestions are very much welcome.

[h1]New Strategy Game[/h1]

[img]http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/11906334/197a865533b06d034554628d1449f32b7b1d9fd6.jpg[/img]

notes.notes:

Today's update includes balancing adjustments for the Revenant faction and several bug fixes. But more importantly, the game is now on Google Play and we're having a free-for-all tournament on all platforms to celebrate, with cool prizes such Steam keys, X-Split licenses, and more. Watch out for a 24-hour livestream on [url=https://www.twitch.tv/towerrushchannel]TowerRushChannel[/url] on Sunday, 6:30AM EST.

notes.title: The Stoneborne DLC is now available! (Patch Notes v1.0.2.16)
notes.notes:
Legends of Callasia’s first expansion pack is here, centered around a new playable Faction: the Dwarves, also known as the Stoneborne! 

The new DLC contains as much content as 1/3 of the main game, including a new campaign, 11 playable Stoneborne heroes, 20 new maps, underground seasons, over 20 new cards, new emblems, new achievements, and a new enemy faction, the Cavespawn.  

http://store.steampowered.com/app/543090

To purchase the DLC, you can click on the Buy Now button in-game if you have the full version, or go directly to the DLC page linked above. A default set of four Stoneborne heroes and the first Stoneborne campaign will be available to all users as a free demo. You can also play in any of the new maps, if the game is hosted by a player who already owns the DLC. Kickstarter backers will receive an email with their Steam keys this week.

notes.title: Summer Sale - Legends of Callasia at 40% off! (New Patch v1.0.1.8)
notes.notes:
Save 40% on Legends of Callasia as part of Steam's Summer Sale! Offer ends July 4th, 10AM Pacific Time. 

The full game is now in the Premium section on Steam as a DLC, which means you can now also gift copies of the game for your friends. We initially launched as Free to Play, with a single optional unlock payment to play across all platforms (Steam, as well as the upcoming Mobile platforms). Feedback from our users indicate that while people love the game, many are confused/troubled by its inclusion in the Free to Play store. We've heard our users and spent the last few weeks rewriting our user management system (no need to register emails anymore) and moving over the game to the right category.

For players who have already purchased the game through the Free to Play store, your account with the game is still completely valid, and your game should work fine. However, since it was unlocked as a Free to Play game, it may still be listed in your Steam library as a "demo" - which we realize may trouble some people. As such, we're also sending a Steam Key to everyone who bought the game. Using that will change your game to "Premium" listing in your library. :)

For feedback, suggestions, and other concerns, feel free to get in touch at legends@boomzap.com.

Thank you and hope you enjoy!

notes.title: Patch Notes v1.0.1.6 - Account Creation Overhaul, Game Adjustments, and Bug Fixes
notes.notes:
We just released an update which primarily changed our system for Account Creation due to a lot of feedback regarding the activation email not being received. There's also a bunch of game adjustments and bug fixes for this one. 

We're also keeping the price of the game at USD 19.99 due to the issue regarding the verification of email addresses to make sure everyone gets a chance to get the game at said price.

[b]Patch Notes v1.0.1.6[/b]
[list]
	[*][b]Account Creation Overhaul[/b]
		[list]
		[*][b]New accounts will now require an alphanumeric account name.[/b]
		[*][b]New accounts do not require an email address.[/b]
		[*][b]Adding an email address to an account is now optional.[/b]
		[*][b]Previous accounts that used an email address will still be able to login by using their email address as the account name.[/b]
		[*][b]NOTE: We are going to be trying out this new system for now due to a lot of feedback from the players that do not receive the activation email. We'll be constantly reviewing this and we might decide to do more adjustments or add restrictions in the future.[/b]
		[/list]

	[*][b]Gameplay Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Chat while setting up a game is now limited to that room only; use [b]/yell (or /y)[/b] to send a message to players in the lobby.
		[*]Changed the behavior of Raze to always completely destroy an Improvement regardless of ownership.
		[*]Adjusted Savil's Horde Master trait to provide 35 Population Limit instead of 50.
		[*]Adjusted Barrage unit trait to deal full damage to one target, and 50% damage to up to 1-3 other targets. Affected units - Archers, Furies, and Gunners.
		[*]Added Bombardment unit trait which deals full damage to one target, and 20% damage to up to 3-5 other targets. Changed Ballista and Artillery trait to Bombardment.
		[*]Changed Frontline unit trait to let Barrage, Bombardment, and Trample to hit multiple targets. With this change, Frontline units will always be the primary target of Barrage/Bombardment units while the other units can still be hit by the splash damage. For Trample, the excess damage can now carry over to other units if the Frontline units die from the Trample attack.
		[/list]	

	[*][b]Campaign Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Revised Win Condition for the final objective of Human Campaign #7.
		[*]Fixed an issue regarding Revenant Campaign #2, #5, and #7 regarding enemy army color.
		[*]Fixed an issue where two of the Orc Tribes in Revenant Campaign #7 do not spawn heroes.
		[/list]

	[*][b]Card Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Shield Bearers and Fine Armor can now be played on non-Merchant heroes.
		[*]Fixed the issue with Partisans card providing more reinforcements to a Neutral Army when played on an ongoing battle.
		[*]Adjusted armies for Peasant Revolt, Summon Tentaklor, Power of the Woods, and Mercenaries.
		[*]Neutral Heroes spawned from Peasant Revolt, Summon Tentaklor, Power of the Woods, and Mercenaries will now start occupying the territory after one turn and their occupy state will now properly be broken if they are attacked.
		[/list]

	[*][b]Map Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Added the Thessonian Sea as a playable 2-player map. Note: Tutorial must be finished to unlock.
		[*]Adjusted starting kingdom for Position 1 of The Isthmus for balancing.
		[*]Added a new sea lane for Sargoth connecting Eastern Sargoth and Stonecutters Landing.
		[*]Fixed alignment issue regarding the Kingdom names for The Isthmus.
		[/list]
		
	[*][b]Others[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Fixed an issue of not being able to reconnect if you get booted or disconnected from a Multiplayer game due to unstable connection.
                [*]Show your Display Name in Main Menu.
                [*]Adjusted sound for button click and mouse over.
		[*]Adjusted UI and text for Account Management due to Account Creation Overhaul.
                [*]Added info on how much gold you earn for that turn on the Seasons part of the UI.
                [*]Adjusted in-game emotes.
		[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes and game stability updates.
		[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 05272016 - Major Changes and Adjustments for Heroes, Units, and Cards
notes.notes:
This week we're doing another balance pass. We've been taking the feedback and data we gathered from the previous week and have applied more changes to supplement or make the game more fun.
[list]
	[*][b]Hero Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*][b]Builder[/b] ability now provides [b]50%[/b] discount when building improvements.
		[*][b]Recruiter[/b] ability now provides [b]33%[/b] discount when buying troops.
		[*][b]Chancellor[/b] ability now provides [b]75%[/b] bonus gold instead of double the gold.
		[*][b]Pillager[/b] ability now provides [b]100%[/b] bonus when razing or winning a battle.
		[*]Standardized Hero cost to 250 gold.
		[*]Adjusted Hero starting armies to balance them out.
		[*]Removed [b]Royalty[/b] ability.
		[*]Added [b]Protector[/b] ability which grants [b]+50%[/b] bonus to Attack when fighting on your land.
		[*]Changed [b]Liberator[/b] to [b]Conqueror[/b] which grants [b]+50%[/b] bonus to Attack when fighting on neutral or enemy land.
		[*]Added traits to [b]Multiclass[/b] heroes - [b]Conqueror[/b] for [b]Hannibal[/b], [b]Siege Master[/b] for [b]Ter[/b], and [b]Melee Attacker[/b] for [b]Olivia[/b].
		[/list]
		
	[*][b]Unit Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*][b]Homeguard[/b] and [b]Rampage[/b] adjusted to [b]+50%[/b] bonus to Defense or Attack instead of double.
		[*][b]Golems[/b] now have [b]Frontline[/b] instead of Trample.
		[*][b]Treants[/b] now have [b]Armor[/b] instead of Frontline.
		[/list]

	[*][b]Card Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*][b]Peasant Revolt[/b] now works like [b]Tentaklor[/b]. It summons a [b]Peasant Hero[/b] with a [b]real peasant™[/b] army that fights any non-neutral army and tries to take over the land where it spawned. 
		[*][b]Rallying Cry[/b] now grants [b]+50%[/b] bonus during the [b]Melee[/b] phase.
		[*][b]Flaming Missiles[/b] now grants [b]+50%[/b] bonus during the [b]Missile[/b] phase.
		[*]Changed [b]Summon[/b] cards to [b]Reinforce[/b] cards (including [b]Creeping Death[/b] and [b]Power of the Woods[/b]). These cards can now only be played on your own land or a neutral/enemy land that has your hero on it but has no battle happening.
		[*]Adjusted [b]Sabotage[/b] card to raze the target land if it has no improvements.
		[*]Adjusted [b]Stealth[/b] card to make your heroes move first regardless of army size.
		[*]Changed [b]Loot Ruins[/b] card to [b]Hidden Treasure[/b] which gives you a random amount based on the target land’s resource. This amount is tripled when played on a land with Ruins.
		[*]Added new [b]Rogue[/b] cards - [b]Steal[/b], [b]Bribery[/b], and [b]Traitor[/b]
			[list]
			[*][b]Steal[/b] takes away 50% of an enemy’s gold income the next turn.
			[*][b]Traitor[/b] reduces the enemy's defense by 50% for 1 turn.
			[*][b]Bribery[/b] does 50% damage to a neutral army.
			[/list]
		[*]Added a new [b]Warrior[/b] card - [b]Siege Machinery[/b]
			[list]
			[*][b]Siege Machinery[/b] nullifies all defensive bonuses for enemies on target land. 
			[/list]
		[*]Added a new [b]Free for All[/b] card - [b]Partisans[/b]
			[list]
			[*][b]Partisans[/b] reinforces a neutral army.
			[/list]
		[*]Changed [b]Negation[/b] card to prevent any hero action and cancels card effects on target land.
		[/list]

	[*][b]Map Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*][b]Hoarfrost[/b] - allowed passage from [b]Aldhammer[/b] to [b]Frostfinger Foothills[/b]
		[/list]
		
	[*][b]Campaign Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Adjusted turn limit for [b]Capture Gondowyn[/b] objective to 15 turns. (4th level in Hundred Kingdoms campaign)
		[*]Fixed target for [b]Defeat Solmallow[/b] and [b]Defeat Aldmallow[/b] objectives. (4th level in Revenant campaign)
		[*]Added a cancel trigger for [b]Ally with Orcs of Caelorien[/b] objective. (4th level in Revenant campaign)
		[*]Added prototype for [b]Campaign Atlas[/b].
		[/list]
		
	[*][b]Other Design/Tech Adjustments[/b]
		[list]
		[*]Added [b]Borderless Windowed[/b] mode.
		[*]Razing bonuses changed to grant half the total building value for razing.
		[*]Nerfed [b]Defense[/b] bonuses for [b]Lands[/b] and [b]Improvements[/b]
		[*]Added a [b]Game Summary[/b] icon in game that allows you to view a turn-by-turn log of the match.
		[*]Hero icons on the "Not all Heroes have been issued a command" message are now clickable and redirects you to that hero.
		[*]Added a [b]Defend All Idle Heroes[/b] button on the "Not all Heroes have been issued a command" message.
		[*]Feedback button now has direct links to relevant social media.
		[*]Miscellaneous bug fixes and stability improvements.
		[/list]
[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes 05212016 - Game Balancing and Campaign Adjustments
notes.notes:
After gathering much feedback from our livestream marathon and from our users, we've decided to do a balance pass for this patch.

[list]
[*]Added reminders for all objectives with turn limits.

[*]Fixed reported bugs for certain campaign levels and increased turn limit for most of the Conquer Kingdom objectives.

[*]Changed Game UI behavior to show details depending on whether an army or land is selected.

[*]Changed the way how neutral army spawning works. Due to this the Summon Tentaklor card behaves differently as it now spawns a Tentaklor hero that you have to fight and will subjugate the land where it was summoned if left alone.

[*]Adjusted Turn Timer for a player that has no valid moves during a Multiplayer game.

[*]Adjusted the Recruiter hero ability to affect the entire stack when hiring units.

[*]Adjusted defense modifiers for Lands, Improvements, and Army States.

[*]Adjusted Game UI to better explain defensive bonuses.

[*]Added two new Unit traits - Homeguard and Rampage. Homeguard doubles the defense of the unit while defending and Rampage doubles the attack of the unit while defending.

[*]Added Homeguard trait to Man at Arms and Rampage trait to Skeleton and Sprigg.

[*]Adjusted Griffon's attack stat to 15 from 20 and added Charge trait.

[*]Changed Death Knight's trait from Armor to Frontline.

[*]Adjusted Fury's attack stat to 15 from 12.

[*]Adjusted Golem's attack stat to 20 from 10 and defense stat to 40 from 50.

[*]Adjusted turn requirement for capturing a City from 2 turns to 3 turns.

[*]Miscellaneous improvements and bug fixes.
[/list]
